Snapshot paths are not defect counts. The actual glob has 17 paths and 17 distinct SHA256 contents; unchanged supporting modules and fixture captures are not additional product failures.
New-support baseline failures, the actual candidate cwd defect, and new fixture premise errors are reported separately. No missing API/import failure is relabelled as a product red.
All 437 tracked baseline test files are byte-exact. This statement does not falsely extend to newly authored test fixtures, whose documented AST changes are enumerated below.
